title: Ask HN: Can we do a "Who's looking for work?"
guide_zh: 除了每月招聘帖，HN 是否也能定期发布“谁在找工作”？
author: jader201
excerpt: I was wondering if HN has considered running a monthly "Who's looking for work", similar to the "Who's hiring" posts that are run every month. Seems like this would be handy for small startups and talent to find each other, or maybe even would allow fellow HNers to help each other find a good fit via networking. Or maybe this was already attempted with bad results?
